spanish: Y saldrá el límite a Zifroná, y serán sus salidas a Hatsar Einán; este será a ustedes límite de norte.

findings.issue: Adds the preposition a: the outgoings are the bare predicate Hatsar Einán (they shall be that place). No preposition or directional suffix licenses motion toward it.
Directional suffix Sd is also spelled into the place name Zifroná, while a already marks that suffix.

notes: The first a is licensed by the directional he on Ziphron; the second a is not.
